doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: Trombonists, old string bands and dance steps
title: Johnny Gould's string band with Big Eye Louis and the island fish trips
summary: Tom describes the old string band of Johnny Gould (violin), Mitchell (guitar) and Ford (bass), with Big Eye Louis Nelson, playing without drums or piano on Saturdays at an island. A man there once slipped into the water with a big box of fish.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation
